meta_desc: Clip a button to your shirt. Click to score. Your phone counts, calls the score and saves your real stats.
og_desc: Clip a button to your shirt. Click to score. Your phone counts, calls the score and saves your real stats.
hero_p: A button on your shirt. Won the point - click. Your phone counts, calls the score out loud and remembers every match.
s1_d: Light and small. You'll forget it's there.
s2_d: Big button. Easy to hit without looking.
s3_t: It all goes to your history
s3_d: Your phone calls the score and saves the match to your history.
try_p: Click a PadelTag below and watch the points add up.
mo1_d: One person keeps score. 1 click - us, 2 clicks - them.
p2_d: Each team gets its own button. Whoever wins the point, clicks.
mo4_d: After the match - who scored the most. Bragging rights included.
st_p: Link your tag to your account once. During the match you see your points, after it everything is in your stats: matches, wins, win rate, history.
st_f3: See your points during the match
ex1_d: The phone says the score. No need to look.
ex2_d: The last point goes back. Easy.
ex3_d: Players with an account see the live score on their own phone. Up to 4 phones - one or two on each side of the net.
ex4_d: Both teams click at once? Point doesn't count.
cta_p: Get the button at any store - about $7–14. Scoring is free forever, subscribe when you want to see your progress.
p1_d: Perfect if one person keeps the score. Or add one to your set.
p4_d: A tag for every player. See who scored the most.
fine: App for iPhone. Cancel your subscription anytime in App Store settings.
dl_p: Point your camera at the QR code, or tap your store.
aud1_t: Don't know the score rules? Just click.
aud1_pain: You mix up 15-30-40 and feel shy to ask.
aud1_gain: Click - your phone says the score out loud. Golden point and tie-break included.
aud2_pain: Lunda says one thing, Playtomic another. And someone with an empty profile wins your bronze.
aud2_gain: Every match is saved: score, partner, opponents. Win rate from real games. Show it - nothing to argue about.
aud3_pain: Tables by hand, the prize goes to the wrong pair, the internet drops - you count again.
aud3_gain: Pairs and courts are set up for you. Every court's score goes straight into one table. Everyone finds themselves by link.
one_h: Not one more app. One less.
one_p: Every club has its own app, plus chats and spreadsheets. PadelTag doesn't book anything - it replaces the score sheet, the chat table and manual stats. Keep booking where you book.
mo16_d: Americano or Mexicano: hand out the tags - pairs, courts and standings set themselves up.
p16_d: A tag for every player. Scores from all courts in one live table.
hero_p_new: No need to remember 15-30-40: click the button and your phone calls the score. You just play. Scoring is free forever.
hero_p_pro: Every point goes into your stats: wins, win rate, match history. Honest numbers instead of “I think we won” - see what works and level up faster.
hero_p_club: Americano and Mexicano without paper: pairs and courts set themselves up, every court's score lands in a live table - on any screen by link.
pf_note: Everything you need to keep score.
pp_l4: Another match's score on your phone
pm_note: Write to us - we'll price it for your club.
pm_l2: Pairs and courts set themselves up
shop_p: A one-button iTag key finder works - usually $7–14 each. Pick your country and we'll show you a store.
new_b1_d: Click and you hear “Thirty, fifteen”. No need to remember 15-30-40.
new_b2_t: It knows the rules for you
new_b2_d: Golden point, tie-break at 6-6 and whose serve it is - all counted for you.
new_b3_d: The last point goes back. No arguing, no recounting.
new_b4_d: Score, voice and every mode - no subscription.
new_try_p: Click the button below: once - point for us, twice - for them, three times - undo.
pro_b1_d: Score, partner, opponents and your points - saved automatically.
pro_b2_d: Matches, wins, win rate and points - right on the home screen.
pro_b3_d: With four buttons every player has their own score. See who carried the match.
pro_b4_d: Both teams click at once - the point doesn't count. Nobody steals a point.
pro_try_p: Four buttons - one per player. Click and watch personal points add up.
club_b1_d: Pairs are made for you - partners and opponents repeat as little as possible.
club_b2_d: Enter the court code and players click their own buttons. Nothing to copy by hand.
club_b3_d: The table updates after every game. Open it by link on any screen.
club_b4_d: Every player gets a button. Points go to individual standings.
club_try_p: This is how every court plays in a tournament: each player has a button, the board counts by itself.
pain_src: Real quotes from padel group chats. We read 46,000 messages.
pq1: "Lunda 2.3 - how much is that in Playtomic?"
pq1_t: Every app rates your level its own way.
pq2: "2.5 and almost no matches" - and they win 6-0.
pq2_t: Stronger players show up in your level.
pq3_t: Tournaments are counted by hand - and the prize goes to the wrong pair.
pq4_t: Nobody knows where to find themselves in the table.
pq5: "15 different apps and WhatsApp groups, no common standard."
pq5_t: Every club has its own app.
pain_ans: PadelTag counts every point and remembers every match.
pain_ans_d: Score, partner, opponents, tournament table - in one place. Nothing to argue about.
faq1_a: Score, voice and every mode are free forever. Only match history, stats and tournaments are paid - with 14 days free.
faq2_a: Any one-button iTag key finder - usually $7-14. Pick your country below and we will show you a store.
faq3_a: Not for scoring - the phone counts on its own. Internet is needed to save the match to your history and to open a tournament table by link.
faq4_a: iPhone for now. Android is coming soon.
app_p: The whole path from Play to your own stats - in a minute. Tap the phone and the buttons below it.
st1_d: One button at the bottom of the screen. No sign-up needed.
st2_d: Click your button - the app knows it's you. Drag a card to swap partners.
st3_d: Won the point - click your button. The phone says the score out loud. Two quick clicks - undo.
st4_d: Pick who won. The match goes to your history.
st5_d: Matches, wins and points - from real games, not guesswork.
